title: 壩基排水廊道~Dam-foundation drainage galleries
focus: 排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化~Gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation
summary: 本課以壩基排水廊道為入口，深入排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Dam-foundation drainage galleries as its entry point, this course examines gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 排水導度敏感度固定上游水頭50 m、出口10 m與入流導度0.002 m²/s，只將排出導度由0.008降為0.004 m²/s。節點穩態水頭H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout)由18升至23.333 m；排水導度減半並不令水頭翻倍。這是線性集總網路兩個穩態的比較，沒有描述堵塞後升壓的時間過程或三維裂隙分布。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and inflow conductance 0.002 m²/s fixed, reducing only outflow conductance from 0.008 to 0.004 m²/s. Steady node head H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout) rises from 18 to 23.333 m; halving drainage conductance does not double head. The linear lumped network compares two steady states, excluding transient pressurization and three-dimensional fractures.
history: 排水廊道把深部水壓轉為可觀測流量，同時容納監測與集排水系統；判讀必須把孔壓、流量、出口水位與構造變形一起放進水力收支。墾務局重力壩設計專書提供揚壓和排水監測背景。 混凝土壩監測手冊出版，官方目錄列明此技術文獻。 接縫止水研究報告完成，說明滲漏與廊道維護的關聯。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Drainage galleries connect deep pressures to observable discharge while housing monitoring and collection systems. Interpretation must combine pore pressure, flow, outlet level and structural deformation within a hydraulic balance. Reclamation gravity-dam guidance provides context for uplift and drainage monitoring. The Concrete Dam Instrumentation Manual is published, documented in the official technical catalog. A joint-waterstop research report is completed, explaining links between leakage and gallery maintenance. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 水力阻力與廊道水頭~Hydraulic resistance and gallery head
units.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭~Hydraulic resistance and gallery head
units.mechanism: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。岩體入流與排水出口共同決定節點水頭，出口淹沒會抬高整個系統的基準。 假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。~Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. It provides finite conductance toward a lower-head boundary, while rock inflow and outlet conditions jointly establish the internal node head and submerged outlets raise that reference. Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. Nonlinear fractures, transient storage and bypass paths can make a single-node model inadequate for locating the cause of deterioration.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network.
units.verify: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。~Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.
units.failure: 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。~Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. Nonlinear fractures, transient storage and bypass paths can make a single-node model inadequate for locating the cause of deterioration.
units.misconception: 只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。~Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location.
units.practice: 以水力阻力與廊道水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic resistance and gallery head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.

units.anchor: 揚壓分布與合力~Uplift distribution and resultant
units.title: 揚壓分布與合力~Uplift distribution and resultant
units.mechanism: 揚壓是沿底面的空間分布，排水位置的低壓點不能代表全底面。把量測頭換成壓力並積分，可以看出排水前後抗滑法向力的變化，但必須保留未量測區域的不確定性。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。~Uplift is a spatial pressure distribution, not the low value at one drain. Converting measured heads to pressure and integrating reveals changes in sliding normal force while retaining uncertainty between and beyond measurement points. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m. Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m.
units.verify: 把孔壓計高程統一到壩底基準，以獨立水位計核對壓力換算；畫出各段面積及量測間距，改用合理上下包絡重算揚力，檢查少數測點對整體積分的控制程度。~Reduce piezometer readings to a common base datum and cross-check conversion with an independent water-level measure. Plot segment areas and spacing, then integrate plausible upper and lower envelopes to assess how sparse readings control total uplift.
units.failure: 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。~Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings.
units.misconception: 單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。~One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base.
units.practice: 以揚壓分布與合力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把孔壓計高程統一到壩底基準，以獨立水位計核對壓力換算；畫出各段面積及量測間距，改用合理上下包絡重算揚力，檢查少數測點對整體積分的控制程度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for uplift distribution and resultant, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reduce piezometer readings to a common base datum and cross-check conversion with an independent water-level measure. Plot segment areas and spacing, then integrate plausible upper and lower envelopes to assess how sparse readings control total uplift.

units.anchor: 排水孔間距與覆蓋~Drain spacing and coverage
units.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋~Drain spacing and coverage
units.mechanism: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。覆蓋概念可先做幾何篩選，再用水力回應驗證相互影響是否連續。 假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。~Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. Uniform collar spacing does not ensure uniform influence, so geometric coverage is preliminary screening that requires hydraulic response evidence to establish continuity. Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant. Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant.
units.verify: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。~Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.
units.failure: 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。~Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee.
units.misconception: 排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。~Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
units.practice: 以排水孔間距與覆蓋編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain spacing and coverage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.

units.anchor: 導水能力的趨勢比較~Conductance trend comparison
units.title: 導水能力的趨勢比較~Conductance trend comparison
units.mechanism: 排水流量必須與驅動水頭一起比較，因為庫水位降低本來就會減少流量。以流量除水頭差得到的表觀導度，可篩選退化趨勢，但仍需辨認岩體入流邊界的改變。 假設同一孔初始Q=0.004 m³/s、Δh=20 m，後來0.003 m³/s、Δh=25 m，表觀導度由0.0002降至0.00012 m²/s，下降40%；穩態線性假設。 流量下降同時伴隨水頭升高通常比單獨流量變化更值得調查，但仍不能僅憑比值定位沉積位置。管路漏失或量測分流也可能造成表觀導度下降而非孔內堵塞。~Drain flow must be compared with its driving head because a lower reservoir naturally reduces discharge. Apparent conductance screens deterioration trends but still requires distinction from changes in rock inflow and outlet conditions. Assume flow and head change from 0.004 m³/s at 20 m to 0.003 m³/s at 25 m. Apparent conductance declines from 0.0002 to 0.00012 m²/s, or forty percent. Lower flow with higher head is more informative than flow alone, but the ratio does not locate deposits. Leakage in collection pipes or unmeasured diversions can reduce apparent conductance without an obstruction inside the drain.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設同一孔初始Q=0.004 m³/s、Δh=20 m，後來0.003 m³/s、Δh=25 m，表觀導度由0.0002降至0.00012 m²/s，下降40%；穩態線性假設。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume flow and head change from 0.004 m³/s at 20 m to 0.003 m³/s at 25 m. Apparent conductance declines from 0.0002 to 0.00012 m²/s, or forty percent.
units.verify: 在相近季節與穩定水位窗口計算導度，核對流量計零點和孔口出流狀態；比對鄰孔及上游孔壓的同步趨勢，區分單孔阻塞、共同出口回水與整片岩體供水改變。~Calculate conductance in comparable seasons and steady-level windows, verifying flow-meter zero and outlet conditions. Compare adjacent drains and upstream piezometers to distinguish local obstruction, shared backwater and a broader change in rock-water supply.
units.failure: 流量下降同時伴隨水頭升高通常比單獨流量變化更值得調查，但仍不能僅憑比值定位沉積位置。管路漏失或量測分流也可能造成表觀導度下降而非孔內堵塞。~Lower flow with higher head is more informative than flow alone, but the ratio does not locate deposits. Leakage in collection pipes or unmeasured diversions can reduce apparent conductance without an obstruction inside the drain.
units.misconception: 排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。~Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
units.practice: 以導水能力的趨勢比較編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在相近季節與穩定水位窗口計算導度，核對流量計零點和孔口出流狀態；比對鄰孔及上游孔壓的同步趨勢，區分單孔阻塞、共同出口回水與整片岩體供水改變。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for conductance trend comparison, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calculate conductance in comparable seasons and steady-level windows, verifying flow-meter zero and outlet conditions. Compare adjacent drains and upstream piezometers to distinguish local obstruction, shared backwater and a broader change in rock-water supply.

units.anchor: 量水堰校正與低流量~Weir calibration and low flow
units.title: 量水堰校正與低流量~Weir calibration and low flow
units.mechanism: 量水堰把水頭轉為流量，非線性指數使水位零點誤差在低流量時特別重要。自由出流、堰口形狀與接近流速都屬校正條件，淹沒後不能照搬原關係式。 率定係數1.4的單位為m^0.5/s。假設已校正九十度三角堰Q=1.4h^2.5，h以m、Q以m³/s，h=0.1 m得0.004427 m³/s；水頭偏高2%約使Q偏高5.08%。 附著物改變堰口形狀，薄水舌黏附也會讓理想曲線失效。若只提高儀器顯示位數而未控制零點與出流狀態，流量數字看似精細卻可能系統性偏差。~A measuring weir converts head into flow through a nonlinear relation, making zero errors especially important at low flow. Free discharge, notch geometry and approach velocity are calibration conditions that submerged operation invalidates. The calibrated coefficient 1.4 has units m^0.5/s. Assume calibrated ninety-degree notch relation Q=1.4h^2.5 with SI units. At h=0.1 m, Q=0.004427 m³/s; a two-percent head bias raises discharge by approximately 5.08 percent. Deposits alter notch geometry and clinging nappes invalidate the ideal rating. More display digits do not improve accuracy when zero and discharge conditions are uncontrolled, leaving precise-looking flow records with systematic error.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：率定係數1.4的單位為m^0.5/s。假設已校正九十度三角堰Q=1.4h^2.5，h以m、Q以m³/s，h=0.1 m得0.004427 m³/s；水頭偏高2%約使Q偏高5.08%。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The calibrated coefficient 1.4 has units m^0.5/s. Assume calibrated ninety-degree notch relation Q=1.4h^2.5 with SI units. At h=0.1 m, Q=0.004427 m³/s; a two-percent head bias raises discharge by approximately 5.08 percent.
units.verify: 以獨立容積計時法交叉查流量，檢查水頭讀取位置、堰口清潔與下游淹沒；將零點偏移傳遞到整條率定曲線，尤其比較低水頭時的相對誤差與可辨識流量變化。查核量水槽的側向漏水。~Cross-check discharge by independent volumetric timing and inspect head-reading location, notch condition and downstream submergence. Propagate zero offsets through the rating curve, comparing relative error and detectable changes particularly at low heads. Check side leakage from the measuring chamber.
units.failure: 附著物改變堰口形狀，薄水舌黏附也會讓理想曲線失效。若只提高儀器顯示位數而未控制零點與出流狀態，流量數字看似精細卻可能系統性偏差。~Deposits alter notch geometry and clinging nappes invalidate the ideal rating. More display digits do not improve accuracy when zero and discharge conditions are uncontrolled, leaving precise-looking flow records with systematic error.
units.misconception: 量水堰水頭偏差百分之二，計算流量也一定只偏差百分之二。~A two-percent weir-head error always produces exactly a two-percent discharge error.
units.practice: 以量水堰校正與低流量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以獨立容積計時法交叉查流量，檢查水頭讀取位置、堰口清潔與下游淹沒；將零點偏移傳遞到整條率定曲線，尤其比較低水頭時的相對誤差與可辨識流量變化。查核量水槽的側向漏水。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for weir calibration and low flow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Cross-check discharge by independent volumetric timing and inspect head-reading location, notch condition and downstream submergence. Propagate zero offsets through the rating curve, comparing relative error and detectable changes particularly at low heads. Check side leakage from the measuring chamber.

units.anchor: 集水井的暫態平衡~Sump transient balance
units.title: 集水井的暫態平衡~Sump transient balance
units.mechanism: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。水量平衡應追蹤啟停延遲與共同排出管的限制，而非只把泵銘牌流量相加。 假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。~A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak. Storage balance must track start delay and common-discharge restrictions rather than merely summing pump nameplate capacities. Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes. Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes.

Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve.

Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds.

units.practice: 以集水井的暫態平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。核對止回閥是否造成倒流。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sump transient balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve.

units.anchor: 廊道熱量與通風尺度~Gallery heat and ventilation scale
units.title: 廊道熱量與通風尺度~Gallery heat and ventilation scale
units.mechanism: 設備散熱、濕空氣與岩體熱交換共同影響廊道環境。簡單顯熱平衡只能估通風尺度，不能取代氣體、濕度與局部氣流評估，也不能作為人員進入許可依據。 假設設備顯熱12 kW、空氣密度1.2 kg/m³、比熱1005 J/(kg·K)、容許教學溫升5 K，Q=12000/(1.2×1005×5)=1.990 m³/s；忽略潛熱與岩體交換。 總風量符合估算仍可能有局部停滯區，濕氣凝結會影響設備與表面耐久。只用平均溫度判斷環境充分性，會漏掉獨立的氣體風險和人員活動需求。~Equipment heat, moisture and rock heat exchange shape gallery conditions. A sensible-heat balance estimates ventilation scale but cannot replace gas, humidity or local-airflow assessment and does not establish personnel-entry authorization. Assume sensible heat 12 kW, air density 1.2 kg/m³, heat capacity 1005 J/(kg·K) and teaching rise 5 K. Flow is 1.990 m³/s, excluding latent heat and rock exchange. Adequate total airflow can coexist with stagnant zones, and condensation affects equipment and surface durability. Average temperature alone overlooks separate gas hazards and occupancy requirements, so the heat calculation cannot establish overall environmental suitability.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設設備顯熱12 kW、空氣密度1.2 kg/m³、比熱1005 J/(kg·K)、容許教學溫升5 K，Q=12000/(1.2×1005×5)=1.990 m³/s；忽略潛熱與岩體交換。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sensible heat 12 kW, air density 1.2 kg/m³, heat capacity 1005 J/(kg·K) and teaching rise 5 K. Flow is 1.990 m³/s, excluding latent heat and rock exchange.
units.verify: 量測設備輸入與散熱比例，在進出口及支廊分別記錄溫濕度和風量；用煙流或等效非侵入示蹤確認短路與死角，將熱平衡殘差留給濕氣和岩體熱交換判讀。~Measure equipment power and heat fractions and record temperature, humidity and flow at inlets, outlets and branches. Use appropriate nonintrusive tracing to identify short circuits and stagnant regions, retaining balance residuals for moisture and rock heat exchange.

Average temperature alone overlooks separate gas hazards and occupancy requirements, so the heat calculation cannot establish overall environmental suitability.
units.misconception: 只要顯熱通風計算合格，就不必再評估廊道氣體與濕度。~Passing the sensible-heat ventilation calculation removes any need to assess gallery gases or humidity.
units.practice: 以廊道熱量與通風尺度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。量測設備輸入與散熱比例，在進出口及支廊分別記錄溫濕度和風量；用煙流或等效非侵入示蹤確認短路與死角，將熱平衡殘差留給濕氣和岩體熱交換判讀。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gallery heat and ventilation scale, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure equipment power and heat fractions and record temperature, humidity and flow at inlets, outlets and branches. Use appropriate nonintrusive tracing to identify short circuits and stagnant regions, retaining balance residuals for moisture and rock heat exchange.

units.anchor: 廊道開孔的應力集中~Gallery opening stress concentration
units.title: 廊道開孔的應力集中~Gallery opening stress concentration
units.mechanism: 廊道是壩體或岩體中的開孔，周圍應力會重分布，局部峰值取決於形狀、遠場荷載與襯砌接觸。圓孔彈性解可用作數值模型的基準，但不代表矩形廊道真實角隅。 假設無內壓圓孔位於無限均質等向線彈性體，遠場單軸壓應力4 MPa，孔邊最大環向壓應力3σ=12 MPa；忽略節理與有限邊界。 尖角的數值應力峰值可能是理想幾何奇異而非可直接使用的材料應力，節理滑移又可能改變受力路徑。只比較最大值而不查平均區域和變形，會誤判損傷。~A gallery opening redistributes stress in concrete or rock, with local peaks controlled by geometry, far-field loading and lining contact. A circular elastic solution benchmarks numerical models but does not represent the corners of a rectangular gallery. Assume an unpressurized circular hole in an infinite homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic medium under uniaxial compression 4 MPa. Maximum boundary hoop compression is 12 MPa, excluding joints and finite boundaries. A sharp-corner peak can be a geometric singularity rather than directly usable material stress, while joint slip changes load paths. Comparing maxima without averaging-region and deformation checks can therefore misidentify damage or apparent numerical improvement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設無內壓圓孔位於無限均質等向線彈性體，遠場單軸壓應力4 MPa，孔邊最大環向壓應力3σ=12 MPa；忽略節理與有限邊界。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an unpressurized circular hole in an infinite homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic medium under uniaxial compression 4 MPa. Maximum boundary hoop compression is 12 MPa, excluding joints and finite boundaries.
units.verify: 先以圓孔基準檢查網格和符號，再換入實際斷面與接觸條件；比對不同位置應變及收斂量，分開溫度變形與荷載反應，並檢查局部峰值是否隨網格細化發散。~Benchmark mesh and signs against the circular solution before introducing actual geometry and contacts. Compare strain and convergence at several locations, separate thermal movement from loading, and test whether local peaks diverge with mesh refinement.
units.failure: 尖角的數值應力峰值可能是理想幾何奇異而非可直接使用的材料應力，節理滑移又可能改變受力路徑。只比較最大值而不查平均區域和變形，會誤判損傷。~A sharp-corner peak can be a geometric singularity rather than directly usable material stress, while joint slip changes load paths. Comparing maxima without averaging-region and deformation checks can therefore misidentify damage or apparent numerical improvement.
units.misconception: 圓孔的三倍應力係數可直接套用到任何矩形廊道角隅。~The circular-hole factor of three applies directly to every rectangular-gallery corner.
units.practice: 以廊道開孔的應力集中編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先以圓孔基準檢查網格和符號，再換入實際斷面與接觸條件；比對不同位置應變及收斂量，分開溫度變形與荷載反應，並檢查局部峰值是否隨網格細化發散。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gallery opening stress concentration, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Benchmark mesh and signs against the circular solution before introducing actual geometry and contacts. Compare strain and convergence at several locations, separate thermal movement from loading, and test whether local peaks diverge with mesh refinement.

units.anchor: 析出沉積與質量收支~Precipitation deposits and mass balance
units.title: 析出沉積與質量收支~Precipitation deposits and mass balance
units.mechanism: 排水通道的沉積可來自化學析出或攜帶顆粒，外觀相似但成因與趨勢不同。溶質濃度差乘流量只能估潛在沉積通量，仍需確認採樣位置、混合與其他反應路徑。 假設流量2 L/s、進出溶解物差20 mg/L且全轉為沉積，日質量2×20×86400/10⁶=3.456 kg/day；非指定礦物且忽略旁路與再溶解。 不同比例水源混合會造成濃度降低而沒有沉積，採樣瓶內反應也會改變結果。即使總質量小，局部狹窄處的沉積仍可能主導水力阻力。~Drain deposits can arise from chemical precipitation or transported particles with similar appearance but different causes. Concentration difference times flow estimates potential deposition only after accounting for sampling locations, mixing and alternative reaction paths. Assume flow 2 L/s and dissolved-mass decrease 20 mg/L, entirely retained as deposits. Daily mass is 3.456 kg/day, without specifying mineral composition and excluding bypass or redissolution. Mixing different waters lowers concentration without deposition, and reactions inside sample bottles alter results. Even small total deposit mass can dominate hydraulic resistance when concentrated at a narrow section rather than distributed uniformly.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設流量2 L/s、進出溶解物差20 mg/L且全轉為沉積，日質量2×20×86400/10⁶=3.456 kg/day；非指定礦物且忽略旁路與再溶解。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume flow 2 L/s and dissolved-mass decrease 20 mg/L, entirely retained as deposits. Daily mass is 3.456 kg/day, without specifying mineral composition and excluding bypass or redissolution.
units.verify: 在同一水團停留時間下配對進出水採樣，分析懸浮與溶解部分並核對溫度酸鹼值；把預估累積量與實際沉積稱量及管徑變化對照，檢查是否有混合稀釋。~Pair inlet and outlet samples with travel time, separating suspended and dissolved fractions and recording temperature and pH. Compare predicted accumulation with measured deposits and diameter change, testing whether dilution rather than precipitation explains the concentration difference.
units.failure: 不同比例水源混合會造成濃度降低而沒有沉積，採樣瓶內反應也會改變結果。即使總質量小，局部狹窄處的沉積仍可能主導水力阻力。~Mixing different waters lowers concentration without deposition, and reactions inside sample bottles alter results. Even small total deposit mass can dominate hydraulic resistance when concentrated at a narrow section rather than distributed uniformly.

units.practice: 以析出沉積與質量收支編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在同一水團停留時間下配對進出水採樣，分析懸浮與溶解部分並核對溫度酸鹼值；把預估累積量與實際沉積稱量及管徑變化對照，檢查是否有混合稀釋。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for precipitation deposits and mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Pair inlet and outlet samples with travel time, separating suspended and dissolved fractions and recording temperature and pH. Compare predicted accumulation with measured deposits and diameter change, testing whether dilution rather than precipitation explains the concentration difference.

units.anchor: 壓力差的不確定度~Pressure-difference uncertainty
units.title: 壓力差的不確定度~Pressure-difference uncertainty
units.mechanism: 判斷壓差趨勢需要把儀器隨機不確定度與共同系統偏差分開。兩個讀值的差可能抵消同源零點，也可能共享溫度誤差；是否相關決定合成規則。 假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa；若相關係數0.5則為sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa。 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。~Interpreting pressure differences requires separating random uncertainty from shared systematic bias. A common zero may cancel while temperature errors remain correlated, so covariance determines how the uncertainties of two readings combine. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa. Difference uncertainty is 3.606 kPa; correlation 0.5 changes it to sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa, with systematic bias assessed separately. Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa；若相關係數0.5則為sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa. Difference uncertainty is 3.606 kPa; correlation 0.5 changes it to sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa, with systematic bias assessed separately.
units.verify: 以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。比較共同零點校正前後差值。~Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation. Add uncertainty bands to trend plots and list uncorrected biases separately rather than treating resolution as accuracy. Compare differences before and after common-zero correction.
units.failure: 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。~Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance.
units.misconception: 兩個壓力感測器的誤差不論是否相關都可以一律平方和開根號。~Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation.
units.practice: 以壓力差的不確定度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。比較共同零點校正前後差值。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure-difference uncertainty, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation. Add uncertainty bands to trend plots and list uncorrected biases separately rather than treating resolution as accuracy. Compare differences before and after common-zero correction.

facts: 教學線性阻力網路節點水頭18 m，排水不代表零壓。~Teaching linear resistance network gives node head 18 m rather than zero pressure.

教學等效半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m留下1 m幾何缺口。~Teaching influence radius 2.5 m and spacing six metres leave a one-metre geometric gap.
